name: Chippai Imouto
source: An insecure little sister barges into her older brother's room and tearfully asks him how she can make her boobs larger.  He has no choice but to do his brotherly duties and support her in any way he can.  After a lot of trial and error, their experiments do not yield any results, but they do result in the pair growing closer...
translation: 一个不自信的妹妹闯进哥哥的房间，含泪问他怎样才能让胸部变大。他别无选择，只能尽哥哥的职责，尽一切可能支持她。经过大量的尝试和失败，他们的实验并没有产生任何结果，但确实让两人越来越亲近了……
